content: While it is obvious that our embeddings can be used as features for new predictive models, it is also very easy to incorporate our learned Dolores embeddings into existing predictive models on knowledge graphs. The only requirement is that the model accepts as input, an embedding layer (for entities and relations). If a model fulfills this requirement (which a large number of neural models on knowledge graphs do), we can just use Dolores embeddings as a drop-in replacement. We just initialize the corresponding embedding layer with Dolores embeddings. In our evaluation below, we show how to improve several state-of-the-art models on various tasks simply by incorporating Dolores as a drop-in replacement to the original embedding layer.
